newsitem.title: USA: Kansas unemployment rate falls to 3.7 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Kansas unemployment rate falls to 3.7 pct in July.

text.p: Unemployment in Kansas dropped to 3.7 percent in July from four percent the month before, the state Human Resources Department said on Monday.
Employment reached an all-time high of almost 1.36 million last month, a gain of about 60,000 jobs since July 1996, when the unemployment rate stood at 4.3 percent, it said.
Farm employment remained high into July, with harvesting running later than usual, the department said. Manufacturing and services sectors also reported further growth.
Seasonal job losses were reported in state government and in state and local schools.
Wichita area unemployment dropped one-tenth of a percentage point to 3.5 percent and Topeka area unemployment dropped to 4.5 percent from 5 percent.
